description: This Java source file defines a specific exception class, 'PolicyEntryNotAccessibleException', which is used within the Eclipse Ditto project to indicate that a policy entry was either missing or inaccessible due to permission issues. The class includes methods for constructing instances from messages or JSON representations, and a nested builder class for fluent object creation.

classes.name: PolicyEntryNotAccessibleException
classes.description: An exception indicating that a policy entry was not accessible due to absence or permission restrictions, with support for JSON parsing and header management.

classes.name: PolicyEntryNotAccessibleException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for creating instances of 'PolicyEntryNotAccessibleException' with a fluent API, supporting customization of message, description, cause, headers, and link.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for constructing a 'PolicyEntryNotAccessibleException', given a policy ID and label.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Constructs an exception from a simple message and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an exception from a JSON object and headers, parsing message details from JSON.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with the specified headers, preserving other properties.
